item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.13
item.description: Send logs is easier: pick Gmail, Outlook, the Mail app or just the zip. Gmail and Outlook open in your browser with the email filled in, so nothing needs setting up on the Mac. Your choice is remembered for the Send logs buttons on error messages.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.12
item.description: Fix: the 'Who is it for?' check showed '(none set)' when the name came from the cut's own burn-in; it now shows the same name as the Spoiler line, and a split never blanks the name in the burn-in. Also: export bin names fit Avid's 64-character limit, and Split works with one press.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.11
item.description: Fix: exports from bins with long names stopped with Media Composer's 'Bin name length must not exceed 64 characters'. The export bins (and the SPLITS bin) now get names Media Composer accepts, shortening the bin's own name if needed. Also in 2.0.10: Split works with one press, and Open a Bin is sturdier.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.10
item.description: Split works with one press: a 'Who is it for?' check pops up with each timeline's Spoiler line, and its Split button goes ahead. The export now pastes the bin's location into Media Composer's Open a Bin window instead of typing it, and presses Open again if Media Composer missed it (it stopped with 'Open a Bin window didn't close').

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.9
item.description: The opening wallet's name is bigger and sized to the window.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.8
item.description: The opening wallet shows the name on two lines, a bit bigger.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.7
item.description: New: your last few bins appear as one-click buttons under 'Bin to split'. When an export or split finishes (or stops with a problem) you get a Mac notification, and the Dock icon shows how many files are done. While exporting it says roughly how long is left, from how long your exports usually take. Error messages have a Send logs button.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.6
item.description: New: a 'Check my setup' button (in the ⚙ panel): Media Composer version, language, and a button that asks macOS for the permissions the export needs, before you start. Stem Splitter remembers which Media Composer versions an export has worked with, and warns if yours is new to it or your Mac isn't in English. After each update you'll see a short note like this one.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.5
item.description: Updates can now bring newer helper tools (Python, ffmpeg). Logs go to apps@drpob.com.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.4
item.description: Fixes a crash on sequences with an AudioSuite effect. Keeps the screen awake while Media Composer exports.
